runtime: Chromium 144 through DevTools Protocol; not Playwright
mode: UI bundle injected into about:blank because managed Chromium policy blocks navigation to localhost; fetch/API responses are mocked in-page. Backend/security behavior is separately covered by node --test.

assertions.name: Blue zone opens after all Yellow CTFs

limitations: Playwright could not be installed in the environment; the UI smoke was driven using Chromium DevTools Protocol instead.
The browser policy blocks all navigable URLs, so the visual smoke uses source injection and mocked API calls rather than a normal HTTP page load.
Frame sequences are individual screenshots, not a recorded video.
Screenshot files from the earlier UI run were intentionally excluded because they contained retired event branding; only text-based smoke results are retained.
